It's another dreaded Disney live action remake. How bad does Doug say this one is compared to the others? Let's take a look at Moana 2026.

Join our YouTube Members - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCiH828EtgQjTyNIMH6YiOSw/join

Watch the new Nostalgia Critic - https://youtu.be/z-2RvNev2jw

Check out our store - https://channelawesome.myshopify.com/

Moana is a 2026 American musical adventure film and a live-action adaptation of Disney's 2016 film of the same name. The third installment and the first live-action film in the Moana franchise, the film was directed by Thomas Kail in his feature directorial debut from a screenplay by Jared Bush and Dana Ledoux Miller. It was produced by Dwayne Johnson, Hiram Garcia, Dany Garcia, Beau Flynn, and songwriter Lin-Manuel Miranda. The film stars Johnson (reprising his role as Maui from the animated films) and Catherine Laga'aia in her film debut as the title character.
